newsitem.title: USA: CAI gets 2-way authorization in Boston.
newsitem.headline: CAI gets 2-way authorization in Boston.

text.p: CAI Wireless Systems Inc said on Friday it was granted permanent authorization from the Federal Communications Commission to use its wireless spectrum for fixed two-way video, voice and data services in the Boston market.
The company said the authorization is a first step in creating a wireless full-service network that provides digital video, voice and data services.

The FCC grant authorizes CAI to send and receive information by way of 16 commercial customer locations served by two cells, with overlapping eight-mile radiuses in and around the Boston metropolitan area. The FCC authorized two additional cell sites for future customer locations.
